item.title: security: ASCII smuggling crosses over from AI prompt injection to phishing evasion
item.description:
Microsoft says Unicode-based “ASCII smuggling,” previously used to hide instructions from AI models, is now being used to obfuscate email content before filters parse it, enabling phishing evasion.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
